items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: But I remember one night Benny Morton -- Remember Benny Morton, the trumbonist?

ctx.x: I'd be happy to see them.

And Morton and I were going -- and the women are beautiful. You can stand on the corner and just see the most beautiful women you ever laid eyes on. So, we went back to Dar es Salaam and from Dar es Salaam we went back to Nairobi, and from Nairobi we caught a plane and crossed the Sahara again and went back to Morocco, Rabat and Casablanca, And we spent a few days buying souvenirs. I bought a couple of big tables. I think that table you see in my house -- that round table -- I bought that in Casablanca. No, in…
That's great. He had engagements at that time --
